name: Open world: an ordinary creature uses Fierce Blow every 6-9.5 s and it cannot be dodged
contract: Ascension combat logs (186 logs, 38,650 Fierce Blow 975011 events) show every hostile creature that melees a player
using Fierce Blow: 206 of the 207 creatures with at least 100 swings on players. Its rhythm follows the clock, not
the swing count: 10% of the intervals are below 6.2 s, the median is 7.9 s, and the per-creature median stays near
8 s whatever the swing speed (correlation 0.11 over 145 creatures). It is never dodged, parried or missed (0 of
38,650, against 44,803 dodges of white swings), as its DBC SPELL_ATTR7_NO_ATTACK_DODGE/PARRY/MISS flags say.
Diseased Young Wolf 299 has no Fierce Blow in any kit, SmartAI or C++ script, so the generic mechanic owns its
cadence. With 150% dodge fixtured on the hero (10020 + 5277), every white swing is dodged, yet each Fierce Blow
still lands: none in the first 5 s of the fight, one within 13 s, and at least three within 35 s.
